title: Plot training progress
description: You display the stored training loss and validation AUC histories.

steps.description: You create a figure and plot hist[loss] with the label train BCE. BCE means binary cross-entropy loss.
You add hist[vauc] with the label val AUC. AUC means area under the receiver operating characteristic curve.

steps.question: How does the chart identify the two plotted histories?
steps.answer: The legend uses train BCE and val AUC from the plot calls. The horizontal axis is labeled Epoch.

steps.description: You title the chart Training progress and display it. The supplied output contains no numeric history values.
